preconditions.description: The length of the given sequence is between 2 and 30000.
The elements of the sequence are integers within the range of -10^8 to 10^8.
All elements in the sequence are distinct.

postconditions.description: The total number of elements in both progressions equals the length of the input sequence.
Both progressions contain at least one element.

postconditions.expression: all(progression1[i+1] - progression1[i] == progression1[1] - progression1[0] for i in range(len(progression1) - 1))
postconditions.description: The first progression is an arithmetic sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(progression2[i+1] - progression2[i] == progression2[1] - progression2[0] for i in range(len(progression2) - 1))
postconditions.description: The second progression is an arithmetic sequence.

postconditions.expression: not any(ai in progression1 or ai in progression2 for ai in a)
postconditions.description: Each element of the input sequence is assigned to exactly one of the two progressions.

postconditions.expression: len(progression1) == 0 or len(progression2) == 0 or (progression1[1] - progression1[0]) != (progression2[1] - progression2[0])
postconditions.description: The two progressions have different common differences or one of them is empty.

postconditions.expression: len(progression1) == 0 or len(progression2) == 0 or (progression1[1] - progression1[0]) == (progression2[1] - progression2[0])
postconditions.description: The two progressions have the same common difference or one of them is empty.
